_readme: PLACES / ALIASES — maps common neighborhood and place names people search for to their canonical district route slug, so visitors can find 'their' area. This file is an ARRAY; the first element is this metadata object, remaining elements are place rows. Row schema: {alias, slug, district, basins:[], lakes:[]}. slug MUST match a real district route slug (e.g. seagrove-seaside-watercolor, santa-rosa-beach-gulf-place-dune-allen, grayton-blue-mountain, watersound-seacrest-prominence-origins, rosemary-beach, inlet-beach, alys-beach, sandestin-miramar-beach-seascape, 30a-stormwater). NOTE ON basins/lakes COLUMNS: these are '[UNVERIFIED]' — coastal dune lake and drainage-basin associations per neighborhood have NOT been confirmed against an authoritative hydrologic map and must be treated as illustrative until verified. TO EDIT: GitHub → PR → Vercel Preview → merge. Do not add per-property dollar figures.
_basins_lakes_note: [UNVERIFIED] — basins[] and lakes[] entries are illustrative associations pending confirmation against an authoritative Walton County / NWFWMD hydrologic basin map. Do not present them as definitive.
